boundary: The orientation bit does not by itself distinguish cold orbital 1 from the chiral union: cold pairs occur in both local signs. The full router needs the independent cold selector plus this two-sheet orientation structure; no H^2 claim is made.
theorem: The paired residue orbitals 8 and 9 carry a literal global orientation bit. PSp preserves either of two cyclic orientations of the three GQ lines through every quotient point; the outer coset reverses it. Among non-cold cross-line triangle pairs, the two orientation signs distinguish orbitals 8 and 9.
